name: cubecen
description: Deploy the app you are working on to Cubecen, fix failed deploys and live errors from the diagnosis, logs and metrics, and wire databases and domains.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy your app from GitHub and get a live URL
interface.longDescription: Deploy the repository you are working on to Cubecen and get a live URL. The agent checks the app is ready (port, start command, framework settings), creates the cube and waits for the release. When a deploy fails or the live app errors, it reads the release's diagnosis, the logs and the metrics, fixes the cause and waits again. It also sets variables and secrets, wires a managed Postgres database, connects a domain, turns on pull request previews and shows your plan's usage.
